title: 20日动量增量研究：30只代码分层A股样本
universe_rule: BaoStock stock basic type=1, IPO date <=2018-12-31, delisting empty or >=2019-01-01; separately SH60/SZ00/SZ30, lexicographic ascending code first10 each; vendor current status is not a filter; freeze names before bars; never replace missing selected stocks
requested_data_end: latest available completed session, resolved by source adapter
added_factor: close_t / close_t_minus_20 - 1, grouped by instrument, no filling
hypothesis: 20-session momentum provides incremental cross-sectional prediction beyond short return and realized volatility under a fixed Ridge model
finalization_rule: Proceed only if discovery mean RankIC increment >0 AND its exploratory HAC95 lower bound >0 AND candidate total net return >fixed baseline AND candidate maximum drawdown no worse (greater or equal signed drawdown). Otherwise report rejection/inconclusive and do not force final. Double-cost and delayed-signal robustness are reported, not tuned.
limitations: Code-stratified sample is not representative of all A shares or a historical index
Vendor basic listing/delisting histories are not independently certified PIT data
SH60/SZ00/SZ30 equally sampled does not imply industry diversification
ST not automatically excluded; unified price-limit proxy may mismatch board rules
Delisting liquidation and actual capacity are not fully modeled
History has been discussed in prior research: do not claim final period is genuinely blind
No parameter search or performance-based sample replacement
